README.md.description: 進度看板的說明：dash.py start／stop／collect、離線快照位置、各線用 progress_post.sh 回報的狀態種類、待裁題與回答、匯總與細節頁、檔案位置

answers.py.description: Read board questions and answers, validate local submissions, and append locked answers.

assets.py.description: Copy board pages and the current reference style with a bundled offline fallback.

codex_api.py.description: Inspect active codex exec processes and safely read their bounded logs and output.

collect.py.description: Collect board state, design and forum snapshots, ELI5 explanations, handoffs, commits, and host samples.

config.json.description: Config for the aos progress board: lines, repos, polling and the LLM summarizer.

dash.py.description: Run the local progress board server, detail, answer and forum endpoints, snapshots, summaries, and ELI5 explanations.

designs.json.description: Hand-written fable design cards for the progress board designs page (one row per design).

designs.py.description: Merge hand-written fable design cards with auto-discovered fable design files for the designs page.

details_api.py.description: Serve read-only progress details, filtered commits, process information, and allowed files.

eli5.py.description: Generate cached everyday Chinese explanations with bounded evidence and recorded costs.

eli5_inputs.py.description: Gather bounded evidence and change fingerprints for everyday progress explanations.

forum.py.description: Local forum store: append-only forum.jsonl events, permission table, and the post/admin command-line entry points.

forum_board.py.description: Build offline forum snapshots and accept validated user posts and replies from the board.

llm_lock.py.description: Serialize board model requests across processes with bounded optional waiting.

remote.description: 進度看板的手機遠端版：claude.ai artifact 頁 remote.html（進度、待你裁、論壇三分頁）與推快照、拉回使用者回答的說明

remote_sync.py.description: Export board and forum snapshots for the phone artifact and write pulled artifact answers back locally.

rounds.py.description: Infer event rounds and collect complete round history with safe mounted reports.

safe_files.py.description: Read bounded UTF-8 text only from regular allowed files beneath configured roots.

static_sites.py.description: Serve configured local sites as read-only files within their resolved roots.

summarize.py.description: Summarize progress, open asks and new user answers through a compatible endpoint.

tests.description: 進度看板的測試：eli5 白話說明的收集、證據、離線與 worker、跨行程模型鎖 llm_lock、輪次收集、靜態站，加幾支驗頁面的 .cjs

web.description: 進度看板的網頁前端：主頁 index、細節 detail、論壇 forum、輪次 rounds、designs、guide 各頁的 html／js／css
